# Vendored from esp32-agent-companion

`sprite-motion.js` is taken unmodified from this repository's
[`web/sprite-motion.js`](../../../../../web/sprite-motion.js), with
`sprite-motion.test.cjs` from [`tests/`](../../../../../tests) alongside it so
the vendored copy stays verified. It is still byte-identical to the original.

Copyright belongs to Dan Wahlin, who has approved this derivative work. The
repository carries no LICENSE file, so that approval is what permits
redistribution - see the credits in [desktop/README.md](../../../../README.md).

Nothing in this directory is modified; if it needs to change, change
`web/sprite-motion.js` or replace it, so the provenance stays clean.
